summary: This document outlines the protocols for monitoring soil organic carbon (SOC) and greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions, including laboratory analysis methods, simulation modeling, and data management for national inventory reporting.

passages.text: GLOSOLAN SOPs (Standard operating Procedures) (FAO, 2019) Recommended option: • Dry combustion (Dumas) Alternative options : • Wet oxidation (Walkley and Black, 1934) • Spectroscopy (Evidence shall be attached) • POC Particulate Organic Carbon (Cambardella and Elliot, 1993): 2 mm and 53 µm sieves. • Autoanalyzer for C. • Analytical balance, ±0.0001 g, to weigh samples and reference materials. • Milling system that meets the requirements of the autoanalyzer manufacturer.

heading_path: Monitoring: SOC projections using SOC simulation models
passages.text: 20-year projection for BAU and Project. Models – No specific model recommended… but Guide using RothC Model is provided.

heading_path: Monitoring: GHG projections using simulation models
passages.text: Ej. GHG emissions (IPCC 2019): CO2; CH4; N2O, (using EXACT or peer reviewed tool).

heading_path: Collecting and Managing Field Activity Data
passages.text: Collecting and Managing Field Activity Data (e.g. crops, yields, fertilzier dose, livestock heads, etc ). Key to characterize business as usual and Intervention/Project scenarios. Key to model SOC changes and GHG emissions. Key for monitoring process (to verify projected activities and deviations). Database for all RECSOIL Projects ...under construction

heading_path: Field Activity Data and SOC ground data generated in Projects
passages.text: E.g. Data from Georreferenced sampling sites – Benchmark sites: Change in SOC stocks could be used to: ground-truth SOC changes estimated by the Tier 1, Tier 2 or Tier 3 model projections over time. Calibrate and evaluate models in different regions; derive tier 2 local EF. Current SOC stocks could be used to update and improve SOC maps (key input for Tier 2-3 estimates of emissions from SOC changes). Ground-truthing activity data.
passages.topic: SOC ground data and model validation

passages.text: Developed through an extensive research, consultation and inclusive process, involving scientists, policy makers, FAO Members, and international and intergovernmental panels. Scientifically robust yet flexible protocols. General Framework – Possibility to adapt specificities to local conditions. Will generate results which can contribute to National GHG inventories. Way forward: Currently working on Pilots and Implementation Manuals. Update - Improvement of the Protocols … “Living documents” : improved as there are more users worldwide, and more and better data is generated.
